mentions.name: Foil Sim
mentions.description: This project is an air/hydro foil physics simulation built for fun, currently in an early stage using rudimentary physics, with plans to add more particles and incorporate Navier-Stokes equations.
mentions.audience: personal use, built just for fun
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on an air/hydro foil simulation (just for fun).  Currently using rudimentary physics and in it's early stages.  Would like to add more particles and incorporate Navier-Stokes equations.
